## 2. Career Philosophy & Mindset Signals

### 2.1 Zero Trust & Default-Deny Governance
- Applied uniformly across physical networks, container clusters, and autonomous agent loops.
- No implicit trust between subagents or external tools. Every action requires time-limited, path-scoped authority receipts.

### 2.2 First-Principles Systems Architecture
- Rejects band-aid fixes and superficial tool-churning.
- Every architectural decision must answer: "What is the physical root cause?", "Where does the state live?", "What are the physical hardware bounds?"

### 2.3 Code Over Prompt (Deterministic Physics)
- Critical boundaries, DLP policies, and compliance contracts are enforced by deterministic code (Python, Go, Bash, Git Hooks), never by probabilistic system prompts.
- Zero vendor lock-in; platform-agnostic harness design.

### 2.4 Epistemic Integrity
- Strict epistemic separation between hypothesis (`[HYPO]`) and physically proven evidence (`[PROVEN]`).
- Every technical claim must cite reproducible physical evidence (command, exit code, log line, or file path).

### 2.5 Boring Truth Over Dramatic Fiction
- If an architecture or component is already verified, minimal, and working, affirm it plainly.
- Reject the temptation to manufacture artificial complexity or fake metrics for the sake of marketing theater.

## 4. Flagship Engineered Systems

### 4.1 g8s (The Gatekeepers)
- Repository: https://github.com/tamld/g8s
- Runtime: Pure Go (1.22+)
- Architecture:
  * Two-Tier Agent Harness: Enables frontier model orchestrators (Claude 3.7 / Opus / GPT-4o) to safely delegate high-frequency mechanical tasks to lightweight worker CLI runtimes (Antigravity CLI, Claude Code CLI, Gemini CLI).
  * Cryptographic Write Receipts: Grants time-limited, path-scoped write authority to prevent unauthorized mutations and codebase drift.
  * Supervisor Fix Loop: Automated execution verification and self-correcting agent loops.

### 4.2 AI-Assisted Infrastructure Operations Platform (IaC)
- Repository: https://github.com/tamld/IaC
- Domain: Production Bare-Metal Homelab & Enterprise SRE Automation
- Key Subsystems:
  * 3-Tier Balanced Architecture: Perimeter Ingress & Identity (Traefik v3, CrowdSec, Tailscale Mesh, Authelia/Pocket-ID IAM) -> AI Gateway & Operations Plane (LiteLLM, SRE Butler Agent) -> Observability Core (VictoriaLogs, VictoriaMetrics).
  * Dual-Plane Observability Mandate: Internal compute health ([LAN]) and public edge reachability ([WAN]) decoupled to instantly isolate network/routing failures.
  * Single Authority Network Identity: MikroTik RouterOS DHCP server is the authoritative single source of truth for MAC-to-IP static lease bindings.

## 5. Architectural Invariants

1. Hardware Reality Invariant (Physical Silicon Bounds):
   All architecture designs are bounded by physical compute envelopes. Proxmox host memory utilization is strictly budgeted (<85% threshold) with zero tolerance for unbudgeted ghost workloads.

2. Anti-Circular DNS Dependency Law:
   Core routing infrastructure (RouterOS, Hypervisor PVE Host) must never depend on containerized ad-blocking resolvers (e.g. AdGuard Home) for upstream DNS. Core substrate always points to Anycast resolvers (1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8) to eliminate deadlocks.

3. Zero-WAN Exposure Law for Core Management:
   Hypervisor management interfaces, RouterOS Winbox/SSH, and internal databases are never exposed to public WAN. Ingress is permitted strictly through Traefik proxied via Cloudflare IP ranges or Tailscale mesh.

4. Fast Batch Telemetry Law:
   Incident triage scripts must avoid sequential SSH loops. Fleet triage uses sub-2-second batch queries and LogSQL filtering to resolve root causes under pressure.

5. Machine-Readable Telemetry Invariant:
   A sanitized JSON snapshot of the active homelab state (hypervisor, memory budget, dual-plane monitoring, and network authority) is published at:
   https://flowaxon.com/data/telemetry.json

6. Visual Architecture Topology & Vector Asset Invariant:
   An authoritative, code-compiled vector diagram illustrating edge ingress (Cloudflare WAF), reverse proxy (Traefik), forward authentication (Authelia), single DHCP authority (MikroTik RouterOS), and dual-plane observability (Uptime Kuma) is published at:
   https://flowaxon.com/assets/diagrams/arch-dualplane-topology.svg
   The asset adheres strictly to the Zero Gradient Law (pure flat industrial fills), 100% OpSec sanitization, and under 25KB byte budget.

## 7. The Evolution: 11 Years in the Trenches to the Symbiotic Frontier

### Chapter 1: The 48-Hour Crucible (Distributed Command under Crisis - 2016)
In 2016, a widespread ransomware outbreak crippled over 100 endpoints across a nationwide retail chain (Thiên Nam Hòa). The recovery succeeded not through chaotic firefighting, but through structured operational decomposition:
- Squad A (Foundation): Environment stabilization and bare-metal Windows staging.
- Squad B (Application): Redeployment of business-critical SAP ERP and iVend POS systems.
- Squad C (Verification): Identity access control verification and login integrity checks.
Pre-built automation scripts and overnight coordinated execution compressed what typically takes weeks into a 48-hour recovery, delivering zero retail downtime on Monday morning.

### Chapter 2: The Departmental Lens (Business Empathy & Domain Decomposition - 2021-2024)
During tenure at Artstuff, systems engineering was practiced through domain-driven business empathy:
- HR Domain: Replaced chaotic, unmaintainable Excel ledgers with an auditable Snipe-IT lifecycle management system.
- Finance Domain: Eliminated single-point-of-failure shared PCs by virtualizing a dedicated MISA accounting server on Hyper-V.
Decomposing corporate friction into departmental domains enabled continuous, incremental daily operational improvements (Kaizen).

### Chapter 3: The Arithmetic of Determinism (The Automation Equation)
"A manual click takes 3 seconds. An automated script takes 3 hours. But 100 flawed clicks will cost 3 years."
True infrastructure reliability comes from an upfront investment in testing, failure analysis, and determinism. This mental model led directly to Tam's AI systems architecture: LLMs cannot be trusted to run on probabilistic prompts; they require deterministic boundary harnesses (Go, Python) and cryptographically verifiable write receipts.

### Chapter 4: The Symbiotic Frontier (Human-AI Symbiosis)
The primal human instinct when encountering exponential technology is fear. Banning AI out of "Terminator" paranoia is an exercise in futility.
Instead, the systems engineer's mission is to architect a trusted, safe, and governed substrate (g8s, Governed AI Second Brain, defense-in-depth). In this environment, AI agents are granted structured domain knowledge and decision-making capabilities within strict capability boundaries, co-existing symbiotically with humans to solve complex real-world problems.
